title: [ingest] Overlay/ghost edges are stored on the CONSUMER workspace, not the provider
summary: A cross-workspace dependency edge lives in the consuming task's overlay, with fromWorkspace marking the provider as a 'ghost'. The provider workspace has no record of the edge. This consumer-side storage is why a missing ghost target resolves to status 'not_ready' rather than erroring.
